record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: For homogeneous ideals I satisfying specified special hypotheses, find sharp upper bounds for reg(I) in terms of the largest degree of an element in a minimal homogeneous generating set of I.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and $S = k[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$ be the standard graded polynomial ring. For a homogeneous ideal $I \subseteq S$, let
$$d(I) := \max\{\deg(f) : f \in G\}$$
for any minimal homogeneous generating set $G$ of $I$ (this maximum is independent of the choice of minimal generating set), and let $\mathrm{reg}(I)$ denote the Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of $I$, defined as
$$\mathrm{reg}(I) = \max\{j - i : \beta_{i,j}(I) \neq 0\},$$
where $\beta_{i,j}(I) = \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}_i^S(I,k)_j$ are the graded Betti numbers of $I$.

In general $\mathrm{reg}(I)$ can be doubly exponential in $d(I)$ and $n$ (as in the Mayr–Meyer-type examples constructed by Bayer–Mumford and others). The problem is:

Identify natural classes $\mathcal{C}$ of homogeneous ideals $I \subseteq S$ defined by specific algebraic or geometric hypotheses (for example, prime ideals, radical ideals, ideals defining smooth/reduced/equidimensional/Cohen–Macaulay schemes, ideals with given codimension or singularity type, etc.), and for each such class, determine a sharp upper bound for $\mathrm{reg}(I)$ as a function of $d(I)$ (and possibly $n$ and $\mathrm{codim}(I)$) valid for all $I \in \mathcal{C}$, together with examples in $\mathcal{C}$ achieving the bound.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of finding sharp upper bounds for the Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of homogeneous ideals in terms of the maximal degree of a minimal generator, under various special hypotheses, is the subject of active research. Some classes have been resolved (e.g., bounds for log canonical local complete intersections, and certain monomial ideal classes), while the general question, including the Eisenbud–Goto conjecture (recently disproved in general by McCullough–Peeva but still open in restricted classes), remains open. No comprehensive sharp bound is known.

status_evidence.title: Some results and questions on Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity (Chardin)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing bounds for regularity in terms of generator degrees under various hypotheses, highlighting open problems.
status_evidence.claim: Sharp bounds for reg(I) in terms of generator degrees remain open in many natural classes.

status_evidence.title: A bound for the Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of log canonical varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a regularity bound assuming I defines a local complete intersection with log canonical singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for specific geometric hypotheses, but no general sharp bound.
